name: Havana
tagline: Colonial plazas, classic cars and son music
summary: Havana is a faded, beautiful colonial capital of pastel plazas, crumbling grandeur and vintage American cars. Wander Old Havana's UNESCO squares, walk the Malecón at sunset and dance to live son in a smoky bar.
seasonNote: November to April is dry. Hurricane season peaks August to October. Expect power and supply shortages.
arrival: José Martí Airport is 30 minutes away. Check entry rules (D'Viajeros form, tourist card).
gettingAround: Walk Old Havana; classic-car taxis and bici-taxis.
cashTip: Bring cash (euros or dollars) and change it at casas de cambio or privately; US-issued cards don't work and ATMs are unreliable. Prices here are shown in US dollars.
foodTip: Ropa vieja, moros y cristianos and paladares.
buyTip: Cigars from official shops, rum and art.
baseArea: Old Havana or Vedado casas particulares
